intro: Seven stories from the last day, rewritten in plain British English. Tap any word you don't know.

items.title: River cruise boat hit by larger vessel in New Orleans
items.text: A much larger boat crashed into the paddlewheel cruise boat American Heritage in New Orleans on Friday and partly submerged it. The Port of New Orleans said about 129 passengers were on board. The mayor's office said several people had been rescued and that the search and rescue operation was still going on. The cruise boat had docked two hours early to begin letting passengers off. Passengers were taken to the port's administration building. Officials did not immediately say whether anyone had been hurt or killed.

gloss.paddlewheel: a boat pushed by a large wheel at the back or side
gloss.search and rescue: the work of looking for people in danger and helping them
gloss.let off: to allow people to leave a vehicle or boat
gloss.dock: to bring a boat to a stop at a place where people can get on or off

items.title: US pushes for European seat at Ukraine talks
items.text: The United States has pushed for European negotiators to join talks between Russia and Ukraine, but Moscow has refused to confirm that this will happen. Meanwhile, the EU has brought Italy and Poland into its peace talks team. EU foreign policy chief Kaja Kallas has also said that the Russians do not want her as the EU's envoy. Separately, Russian drone attacks hit a hospital in Kyiv.

gloss.negotiator: a person who takes part in talks to reach an agreement
gloss.join: to become part of a group or activity
gloss.envoy: a person sent to represent their government

items.title: Finland publishes plan to end fossil fuels
items.text: Finland has published a plan to phase out fossil fuels while the COP31 climate summit in Turkey avoids the issue. More than 96 per cent of Finnish electricity is already non-fossil, and the country aims to be carbon neutral by 2035. However, it has not set a legally binding deadline. The United Nations says fossil fuels cause around 68 per cent of global greenhouse gas emissions. COP31 ends on 20 November.

gloss.carbon neutral: adding no extra carbon dioxide to the air overall
gloss.deadline: the latest time by which something must be done
gloss.greenhouse gas: a gas, such as carbon dioxide, that traps heat around the Earth

items.title: Microsoft outage hits Outlook, Teams and Copilot
items.text: A Microsoft outage disrupted thousands of users of Outlook, Teams and Copilot this week. The company said it was seeing continued recovery progress across regions. Many people had to look for other ways to read email and keep working while the services were down. Experts have been explaining what went wrong and whether users' data is at risk.

gloss.outage: a period when a service does not work
gloss.disrupt: to stop something from working normally
gloss.recovery: the process of returning to normal
gloss.region: a large area of a country or the world
gloss.at risk: in danger of being harmed or lost

items.title: Mercedes-Benz stops new investment in German plants
items.text: Mercedes-Benz has halted new investment in its German plants and is considering closing some of them. The report was published on 12 November. The news is a further sign of pressure on the European car industry. The company has not been quoted here with any further details.

gloss.investment: money put into a business to help it grow
gloss.closure: the permanent shutting of a business or factory
gloss.consider: to think carefully about doing something

items.title: EU Russian gas bill reaches 8.7 billion euros
items.text: The European Union spent 8.7 billion euros on Russian Arctic liquefied natural gas (LNG) in 2026, according to a report published on 12 November. An import ban on Russian LNG is coming soon. Separately, the International Energy Agency says European diesel prices are staying high even though global oil supply has overtaken demand.

gloss.import ban: an official rule that stops goods coming into a country
gloss.liquefied natural gas: gas cooled into a liquid so it can be shipped
gloss.loom: to be about to happen, in a worrying way
gloss.demand: the amount of something people want to buy

items.title: GTA VI day one patch starts rolling out on PS5
items.text: A day one patch for Grand Theft Auto VI, version 1.002, has started rolling out to some PlayStation 5 players. It is about 1 GB in size. According to a PlayStation Game Size post, Sony is releasing it in stages, with the first half of users getting it now and the rest about 11 hours later. There are no official patch notes yet. The game cannot be played until midnight local time on 19 November.

gloss.patch: a small update that fixes or improves a game
gloss.in stages: in several steps, not all at once
gloss.patch notes: a list of changes in an update
gloss.local time: the time in the place where you are
